spine: 1. CLAUDE.md 這類 agentic 指令檔在真實 repo 裡只會變大：247,694 條指令生命週期、1,867 個 repo 的統計顯示整體成長 +226%，平均每次 commit 淨增 4.9 條指令，直到 repo 退休或整份檔案被重寫為止。
2. 第一個直覺解釋「過時論」被數據推翻——如果指令只是過時該被清掉，刪除風險（hazard）應該隨年齡上升；實測恰好相反，指令越老越不容易被刪，log-hazard 斜率是 -0.032/commit。
3. 第二個候選「單純沒人管」也站不住：如果只是隨機疏忽，hazard 隨年齡下降的速度不該因為維護者人數而不同；但多作者交參與的檔案中，這個下降明顯更陡（β_multi-author×age = -0.021，z=-11.7），指向一個更具體的機制——理由跟著人一起流失。
4. 真正驅動成長的機制是作者命名的「catastrophic remembering」：新增一條指令的記錄成本是 O(1)，但要安全刪掉一條（不引發回歸）得驗證它是否被其他 O(2^|D|) 種組合依賴——一旦寫下這條指令的理由沒留下來，後繼維護者只能選擇保留。
5. 論文用一個可控實驗直接檢驗這個機制假說：把 IFEval 反過來構造出「最優指令集合已知」的可驗證世界，讓維護者在指令旁邊寫下「解釋理由」的 comment——結果 excess instruction 從 +211.3% 降到 +1.4%，減少了 99.3%。
6. 換到真實場景的 WildIFEval，同樣的 comment 機制讓 agent 的真實指令遵循率提升到最多 23.1%（50.4% → 62.0%，經過 3 輪維護），證明「寫下理由」不只是讓檔案變瘦，還真的改善了 agent 行為。
7. 論文自己給的建議：coding agent 工具可以提供 comment 語法把理由傳下去，但刪除仍應保留人在迴路——這篇是觀察 + 受控實驗的混合證據，控制實驗規模（2-3 條指令的 cover）遠小於真實檔案的中位數 39 條指令，是需要誠實標注的落差。

perspective.mechanism: 摘要把整個論文的因果鏈壓縮成一句話：新增指令的記錄成本是 O(1)，但確認一條舊指令可以安全刪掉，等於要驗證它跟現有 |D| 條指令的所有子集合是否互相依賴，成本是 O(2^|D|)——這個不對稱本身就是成長的引擎。
perspective.tradeoff: 論文提出的解法（comment 記錄理由）用維護者多打幾行字的成本，換取後繼者不用再猜「這條為什麼在這裡」；但寫理由本身也是額外負擔，且論文承認控制實驗只驗證了 2-3 條指令規模的 cover，離真實檔案中位數 39 條指令還有距離。
perspective.reader_use: 任何維護 CLAUDE.md / .cursorrules / AGENTS.md 這類 agent 指令檔的工程師，可以直接把「這條指令為什麼存在」寫成緊鄰的 comment，而不是只把規則本身寫進去——論文的受控實驗顯示這個習慣本身就能讓檔案膨脹幅度從三倍以上降到幾乎不漲。

perspective.mechanism: PDF 是原始排版來源，但本次 fetch 只拿到二進位內容，模型無法可靠解析出文字（回報「無法解析 PDF 的壓縮串流」），因此本文所有數據改以 HTML 版本 (arxiv.org/html) 為準。
perspective.tradeoff: PDF 抓取失敗代表沒有第二個獨立管道核對 HTML 版本的轉寫是否完全準確；本文因此只採用 HTML fetch 回傳中帶引號、標明段落出處的句子作為引用依據。
perspective.reader_use: 若之後要覆核本文引用，建議直接用瀏覽器打開 PDF 而非仰賴自動抓取，或改用 arxiv.org/html/2608.11095v1 的渲染版本。

perspective.mechanism: HTML 渲染版本補上了摘要頁沒有的方法論細節：instruction / payload 的操作型定義、1,867 個 repo 如何被追蹤成 299,440 次版本轉換、log-hazard 迴歸模型如何分離「過時論」與「記憶流失論」兩個相反的預測方向。
perspective.tradeoff: 第 3 節的存活分析是觀察性資料，只能建立相關；真正的因果證據來自第 4 節的受控介入實驗（IFEval 反轉 + WildIFEval），論文自己也把兩者分開處理，沒有把觀察相關性直接當因果。
perspective.reader_use: 工程師可以把「多作者維護的檔案 hazard 下降更快」這個交互作用當成一個可以自己驗證的訊號——如果團隊的 CLAUDE.md 換過好幾任維護者又幾乎沒人敢刪東西，這篇論文的機制論就直接對得上團隊自己的經驗。

notes.quote: Agentic coding READMEs like this http URL grow without bound in real repositories, stopping only when the repository retires or someone rewrites the file wholesale.
notes.interpretation: 論文開場直接定調：這不是「偶爾會變大」，而是「不會自己停」，唯二終點是 repo 死亡或整份重寫。

notes.quote: agentic prompts grow without bound, more than tripling over their lifetime (+226%), gaining +4.9 net instructions every commit
notes.interpretation: 核心統計：整個生命週期成長 226%（略多於三倍），平均每次 commit 淨增 4.9 條指令（新增減去刪除後的淨值）。

notes.quote: the older an instruction gets, the less likely it is to be deleted (log-hazard -0.032/commit)
notes.interpretation: 刪除風險（hazard）的對數斜率是負的，代表存活分析模型裡「年齡」這個變數會壓低被刪機率，而不是提高。

notes.quote: First, we characterize this phenomenon across 247,694 instruction lifetimes in 1,867 repositories
notes.interpretation: 資料規模：247,694 條「指令生命週期」（一條指令從出現到被刪除或至今仍存在的完整記錄），涵蓋 1,867 個 GitHub repo。

notes.quote: prompt comments can halt the growth: inverting IFEval yields verifiable worlds whose optimal prompts are known, and there comments encoding latent reasoning remove 99.3% of excess instructions
notes.interpretation: 介入實驗的頭條結論：在「最優指令集合已知」的可驗證世界裡，讓 comment 帶著推理過程可以清掉 99.3% 的多餘指令。

notes.quote: applying the same inversion to WildIFEval, we show that prompt comments can improve real-world agentic instruction-following by up to 23.1%
notes.interpretation: 同一個 comment 機制搬到真實場景資料集 WildIFEval 後，agent 的指令遵循率最多提升 23.1%——不只是檔案變瘦，行為也變好。

notes.quote: Under catastrophic forgetting, a gradient learner overwrites what it should have kept; under catastrophic remembering, a maintainer keeps what they should have overwritten.
notes.interpretation: 論文為現象命名的核心類比：catastrophic forgetting 是「該記住的被覆蓋掉」，catastrophic remembering 反過來是「該丟掉的被留住」。

notes.quote: Successive edits by multiple authors destroy that latent reasoning, so deletion hazard decays with age, additions outrun removals, and instructions grow without bound
notes.interpretation: 作者把因果鏈講清楚：多人接力編輯會把「當初為什麼寫這條」的隱性理由沖掉，理由沒了刪除就變危險，於是新增速度長期贏過刪除速度。

notes.quote: Recording an instruction's latent reasoning costs O(1), but reconstructing it costs O(2^|D|) for a prompt with |D| instructions
notes.interpretation: 論文的理論框架核心：寫下理由的當下成本是常數，但事後想從整份指令集合裡反推「這條理由是什麼、刪了會不會壞事」，成本是指令總數的指數級——這是論文自己提出的複雜度模型，不是直接測量出來的數字。

notes.quote: An honest audit therefore costs O(2^|D_t|) subset probes, and D* is incomputable in general.
notes.interpretation: 延伸前一個複雜度論證：想誠實審查整份指令檔（判斷每條是否還必要）需要窮舉子集合，而理論上的「最優指令集合」D* 在一般情況下根本算不出來。

notes.quote: We call one clause-level imperative an _instruction_ and everything else in the file payload.
notes.interpretation: 論文對「指令」的操作型定義：一個子句層級的祈使句算一條指令，檔案裡其他文字（說明、範例、標題等）算 payload，不計入指令統計。

notes.quote: Our corpus spans 1,867 GitHub repositories, 1,801 multi-version files, 299,440 version-to-version transitions, and 247,694 instruction lifetimes
notes.interpretation: 資料集規模的完整版本：1,867 個 repo 對應到 1,801 個「至少有兩個版本」的檔案，追蹤了 299,440 次版本間轉換，從中萃取出 247,694 條指令生命週期。

notes.quote: instruction staleness and imperfect recall predict opposite slopes for deletion hazard: the first predicts hazard rising with age...the second predicts it falling
notes.interpretation: 論文明確把「過時論」和「記憶流失論」設計成互斥的可證偽預測：過時論預測 hazard 隨年齡上升，記憶流失論預測 hazard 隨年齡下降；實測是下降（見 n03），所以支持後者、推翻前者。

notes.quote: β_multi-author×age = -0.021 (z=-11.7)
notes.interpretation: 決定性的交互作用檢定：多作者維護的檔案，hazard 隨年齡下降的速度比單一作者維護的檔案更陡（多一個負向係數 -0.021，z 值 -11.7 代表統計上非常顯著）。這是區分「單純沒人管」和「理由跟著人流失」兩種解釋的關鍵證據——如果只是隨機疏忽，作者人數不該讓下降速度系統性變化。

notes.quote: the mean instruction count rises monotonically through t=-1, drops to 59.5% of its pre-rewrite value at t=0, and recovers to 91.5% over the 10 commits after
notes.interpretation: 描述「整份檔案被重寫」這個成長曲線的唯一煞車點附近發生的事：重寫前指令數持續上升，重寫那一刻砍到剩 59.5%，但接下來 10 次 commit 內又幾乎回到 91.5%——重寫只是暫時清空，不是解法。

notes.quote: agentic prompts grow faster after a rewrite: a file gains 4.9% instructions per commit after a mass rewrite vs. 4.1% before it.
notes.interpretation: 重寫之後成長率（百分比意義上的每 commit 成長速度）反而比重寫前更快（4.9% vs 4.1%）——這是與 n02 的「+4.9 net instructions」不同的量（一個是淨增條數，一個是成長百分比），本文行文須明確分開避免混用。

notes.quote: excess size, |D_t|/|D*| - 1
notes.interpretation: 「excess」的精確定義：目前指令數除以理論最優指令數 D* 再減一，也就是「超出最優集合的比例」。D* 定義為「使預期滿足約束程度最大化的最小指令集合」。

notes.quote: prompt comments enable prompts to settle near D*: excess drops from +211.3% to +1.4%
notes.interpretation: 受控實驗（IFEval 反轉）在 T=51 步之後的最終狀態：沒有 comment 的維護者最終 excess 停在 +211.3%（也就是指令數是最優值的三倍多），有 comment 的維護者則收斂到 +1.4%，幾乎等於最優。

notes.quote: Comments lift satisfaction from 50.4% to 62.0% over 3 maintenance rounds (11.6pp, 95% CI: [5.1, 18.3]pp), a 23.1% relative gain
notes.interpretation: WildIFEval 真實場景實驗的完整數字：3 輪維護後，指令滿足率從 50.4% 提升到 62.0%（絕對值差 11.6 個百分點，95% 信賴區間 5.1 到 18.3pp），換算成相對提升是 23.1%。

notes.quote: Coding agent developers can give prompts a comment syntax, so an instruction's latent reasoning can reach the next maintainer.
notes.interpretation: 論文對業界工具開發者的建議是可行性層面的（「可以」而非「應該立刻」），本文轉述時保留這個「可以」的力度，不升級成強制建議。

notes.quote: covers of two or three instructions against a median file's 39
notes.interpretation: 論文自己承認的規模落差：受控實驗（IFEval 反轉）驗證的是 2-3 條指令的最優集合，而真實 CLAUDE.md 檔案的中位數指令數是 39 條——受控實驗證明機制成立，但規模比真實情況小得多，是需要誠實標注的限制。

notes.quote: for K=1 and G=16, those noisy instructions cost 24.1pp of correctness on the true instructions already in the prompt
notes.interpretation: WildIFEval 實驗裡一個容易被忽略的細節：從其他題目隨機抽來、跟眼前任務無關的雜訊指令（K=1 條真指令混入 G=16 條雜訊指令的設定下）不是中性堆積，會實際拖累 agent 對已經在提示詞裡的真正需要指令的遵循表現，代價是 24.1 個百分點的正確率。修正：雜訊指令的定義是「隨機混入、與任務無關」，不是「沒有寫清楚理由」——後者是 comment 介入實驗要處理的另一個變因，兩者不可混為一談。

notes.quote: [Submitted on 11 Aug 2026]
notes.interpretation: arXiv 頁面自身的投稿紀錄行，確認提交日期為 2026 年 8 月 11 日；頁面作者欄只列出 Kushal Chakrabarti 一人，且沒有 journal-ref（未經同儕審查的 v1 preprint）。支持前言段落「這篇論文只有一位作者，8 月 11 日才掛上 arXiv，還沒經過同儕審查」的完整說法。

notes.quote: this setting is observed, not assigned; we turn next to one where we control what the maintainer inherits.
notes.interpretation: 第 3 節作者自己給的方法論定位句：第 3 節的資料是「observed, not assigned」（觀察到的，不是實驗指派的），只能建立相關；第 4 節才是「control」（受控）的設定。直接支持前言段落「第 3 節的資料是觀察性的，只能建立相關；真正的因果證據要留到第 4 節的受控實驗才出現」。

claims.note: Paper reports a 95% bootstrap CI [-0.047, -0.019] on the slope which the post omits; omission only, no misstatement. The post's 「存活分析（survival analysis）」 framing matches §3.4's Nelson–Aalen estimator on 28,426 deletions.

claims.claim_text: 換算成曲線大概是這樣：一條指令活到第 50 次 commit 時，相對被刪機率只剩剛出生時的兩成左右／曲線由論文報告的 log-hazard 斜率（-0.032/commit）換算而得，非論文原圖
claims.location: under H2「一次 commit 淨增 4.9 條指令的檔案」, hazard-decay chart
claims.evidence: log-hazard -0.032/commit (source); exp(-0.032 × 50) = 0.202, i.e. ~20%
claims.note: TARGETED CHECK — chart derivation declaration is ACCURATE. The figcaption states 「曲線由論文報告的 log-hazard 斜率（-0.032/commit）換算而得，非論文原圖」 and the affordance line repeats 「曲線換算自 log-hazard 斜率」, so the derivation is marked in two places. Arithmetic audit of the SVG path: plotted points at ages 0/10/20/30/40/50/60/70/80 map to exp(-0.032·age) = 1.000/0.726/0.527/0.383/0.278/0.202/0.147/0.107/0.078, matching the path's y-coordinates (40/111.2/162.9/200.5/227.7/247.5/261.9/272.3/279.9) exactly; the slider readout formula is the same exponential. The derived curve is NOT presented as the paper's own data anywhere: the paper does have its own Figure 5 (Nelson–Aalen hazard vs age) but the post never references or reproduces it, and the dataset table's figcaption 「數字為論文報告的原始統計，未經本文加工」 covers only paper-reported scalars (all 12 rows check out as paper figures) and contains no derived curve value. Marked inference, correctly bounded.

claims.claim_text: 一份從 10 條指令起步的新專案，只要新增持續小幅贏過刪除，不用太多次 commit 就可能逼近論文報告的 39 條中位數規模
claims.location: under H2「一次 commit 淨增 4.9 條指令的檔案」
claims.evidence: gaining +4.9 net instructions every commit; the median file holds 39 instructions
claims.note: Explicitly marked as the author's extrapolation in the same paragraph: 「這是把論文的平均速度往前推算的說法，不是論文本身給出的具體案例」. Deliberately vague (「不用太多次」) rather than asserting a specific commit count — deflated relative to what the arithmetic would license. Legitimate marked inference.

claims.claim_text: 過時論和「記憶流失」論對 hazard 隨年齡變化的方向給出完全相反的預測，前者預測 hazard 隨年齡上升，後者預測它下降
claims.location: under H2「指令只是過時了？」+ tabs widget
claims.evidence: instruction staleness and imperfect recall predict opposite slopes for deletion hazard: the first predicts hazard rising with age...the second predicts it falling (§3.4)
claims.note: The post attributes the falsifiable-prediction framing to the paper and the paper does construct it that way. The follow-on 「單看這一個係數，過時論就站不住腳」 is a falsification claim the paper's own design licenses.

claims.claim_text: 多作者維護的檔案裡，hazard 隨年齡下降的速度明顯更陡，交乘項係數是 -0.021（z=-11.7，統計上非常顯著）
claims.location: under H2「只是沒人管，純屬疏忽？」+ tabs widget
claims.evidence: β_multi-author×age = -0.021 (z=-11.7) (Appendix A.8, Table 6)
claims.note: Coefficient, sign, and z-statistic all match. The post's reading of the interaction ('the age effect is amplified in multi-author files, not two additive main effects') is stated as an explanation of the statistic, and the post keeps the inference hedged at 「指向」 rather than asserting causation — appropriate for observational data.

claims.claim_text: 在 catastrophic forgetting 底下，梯度學習器覆蓋了它該保留的東西；在 catastrophic remembering 底下，維護者保留了他該覆寫掉的東西
claims.location: under H2「真正的原因：刪除的代價是 2 的 |D| 次方」
claims.evidence: Under catastrophic forgetting, a gradient learner overwrites what it should have kept; under catastrophic remembering, a maintainer keeps what they should have overwritten. (§1)
claims.note: Presented as 「作者的說法是」 — attributed paraphrase, faithful clause-for-clause to the source sentence.

claims.claim_text: 記錄一條指令的隱性理由，成本是 O(1)……反推「這條理由是什麼、刪了會不會連動壞掉某個沒寫出來的邊界情況」，成本是 O(2^|D|)……理論上的 D*……在一般情況下根本算不出來
claims.location: under H2「真正的原因」, glossary popover widget
claims.evidence: Recording an instruction's latent reasoning costs O(1), but reconstructing it costs O(2^|D|) for a prompt with |D| instructions (§2); An honest audit therefore costs O(2^|D_t|) subset probes, and D* is incomputable in general. (§2)
claims.note: Checked for experimental force: the post frames this as the paper's complexity argument (「論文把這個直覺寫成一個複雜度論證」, 「理論上得把……推演一遍」), not as a measurement. Matches n09's own caveat that this is a proposed model rather than a measured quantity.

claims.claim_text: excess 論文定義：目前指令數除以 D* 再減一，衡量「超出最優集合多少比例」／D* 論文定義：讓約束滿足程度最大化的最小指令集合
claims.location: glossary popover widget
claims.evidence: excess size, |D_t|/|D*| - 1 (§2)
claims.note: Definition matches the source formula.

claims.claim_text: 論文把指令本身藏起來，只留下背後的驗證器（verifier）當作隱性的約束集合……這樣一來，真正的最優指令集合 D* 是已知的，可以精確算出每一步的 excess 是多少
claims.location: under H2「把理由寫進 comment，excess 從 +211.3% 掉到 +1.4%」
claims.evidence: inverting IFEval yields verifiable worlds whose optimal prompts are known; the paper hides the original instructions D_j, treating them as the known reference minimum cover D*, with the verifiers C_j as the hidden constraint set; two arms compare maintainers with vs without latent-reasoning comments (§4, Appendix B)
claims.note: The bound note n05 covers only the headline 'verifiable worlds whose optimal prompts are known'; the mechanical detail (instructions hidden, verifiers retained, two arms) exceeds the note's quote. Re-fetch of the HTML rendering confirms the post's description of the setup is accurate in every particular, so this is a partial-trace gap rather than a factual problem — adding a methods note would close it.

claims.claim_text: 從觀察資料到受控實驗，論文用的是同一把尺——不管是第 3 節的真實 GitHub 資料，還是第 4 節的模擬環境，衡量的都是同一個 excess 比例
claims.location: under H2「真正的原因：刪除的代價是 2 的 |D| 次方」, bridging paragraph
claims.evidence: calculating excess size requires minimum cover, which is incomputable in general (§2); An honest audit therefore costs O(2^|D_t|) subset probes, and D* is incomputable in general. (§2); §3 reports raw instruction counts, +226% lifetime growth, +4.9 net instructions/commit, log-hazard -0.032/commit and rewrite dynamics — it never reports an excess-over-D* figure for real repositories.
claims.note: CONTRADICTS THE SOURCE. Excess (|D_t|/|D*| - 1) is computable only in the inverted IFEval/WildIFEval testbeds, precisely because D* is known there by construction; the paper states D* is incomputable in general and reports no excess figure for the field corpus. The ledger's own n10 already records the incomputability. The post's claim that both halves of the paper measure 'the same excess ratio' is false, and it inverts the actual reason the inversion methodology was needed. Fix: rewrite to what the source says — §3 measures growth and deletion hazard on real files where D* is unknowable, and §4 constructs a world where D* is known so excess becomes measurable at all.

claims.claim_text: 有 comment 的那組收斂到 +1.4%，幾乎貼著最優值。換算下來，寫 comment 這一個習慣清掉了 99.3% 的多餘指令
claims.location: under H2「把理由寫進 comment，excess 從 +211.3% 掉到 +1.4%」+ dataset table + H2 heading
claims.evidence: prompt comments can halt the growth: inverting IFEval yields verifiable worlds whose optimal prompts are known, and there comments encoding latent reasoning remove 99.3% of excess instructions (+211.3% to +1.4%); prompt comments enable prompts to settle near D*: excess drops from +211.3% to +1.4% (§4.2)
claims.note: Numbers, the T=51 step (Table 2 / Fig. 1a), the 99.3% reduction, and 'settle near D*' for the comment arm all confirmed. The post's 「指令數是最優值的三倍多」 for +211.3% excess is arithmetically right (ratio 3.113). The paper reports half-CIs of ±105.3pp and ±22.1pp on the two excess figures which the post and its table omit — omission only. The post's 「這不是相關性，是……直接對照」 is applied to the controlled experiment, which is where experimental force legitimately belongs.

claims.claim_text: 跑到第 51 步之後，沒有 comment 的那組指令集合穩定停在 excess +211.3%
claims.location: under H2「把理由寫進 comment，excess 從 +211.3% 掉到 +1.4%」
claims.evidence: Excess rises to +211.3±105.3 in the control arm at T=51, indicating continued growth, not plateauing; the treatment arm reaches +1.4±22.1. The word 'settle' in 'prompt comments enable prompts to settle near D*' describes the COMMENT arm only.
claims.note: The post transposes the source's 'settle' onto the wrong arm. The paper describes the no-comment arm's excess as still rising at T=51, not stabilising, and the ±105.3pp half-CI makes 「穩定」 doubly unsupported. Note that the correction runs in the post's own favour — a still-rising control arm strengthens the 「只會變長」 thesis — but as written the sentence asserts a plateau the source does not report. Fix: 「跑到第 51 步，沒有 comment 的那組 excess 已經升到 +211.3%」.

claims.claim_text: 經過 3 輪維護，有 comment 那組的指令滿足率從 50.4% 提升到 62.0%，絕對值差 11.6 個百分點（95% 信賴區間 5.1 到 18.3pp），換算成相對提升是 23.1%
claims.location: under H2「把理由寫進 comment……」+ dataset table
claims.evidence: Comments lift satisfaction from 50.4% to 62.0% over 3 maintenance rounds (11.6pp, 95% CI: [5.1, 18.3]pp), a 23.1% relative gain (§4.3)
claims.note: Every figure matches, including the CI the post carries. The abstract hedges as 'by up to 23.1%' while §4.3 states 'a 23.1% relative gain' flatly for this 3-round comparison; the post cites the 3-round result, so dropping 'up to' is not inflation. The post correctly describes WildIFEval as human-written constraints rather than programmatic verifiers — confirmed: 'WildIFEval's constraints are human-written prose and ship with no code verifiers'.

claims.claim_text: 那些沒有寫清楚理由的雜訊指令……它們會拖累 agent 對已經在提示詞裡的真正需要指令的遵循表現，代價是 24.1 個百分點的正確率
claims.location: under H2「把理由寫進 comment……」
claims.evidence: for K=1 and G=16, those noisy instructions cost 24.1pp of correctness on the true instructions already in the prompt, 65.6% at G=0 against 41.5% here (§4.3). The paper attributes the 24.1pp to noise instructions drawn uniformly from other benchmark items, not to instructions lacking recorded rationale.
claims.note: The 24.1pp number and its effect (noise instructions degrading compliance with the genuine instructions already in the prompt) are verified verbatim. The misattribution is the qualifier 「沒有寫清楚理由的」: the source's noise instructions are injected distractors sampled from other benchmark items, and the link to missing rationale comes from the separate comment intervention, not from the noise diagnosis. Also note the figure is conditioned on K=1, G=16, which the post drops. Fix: drop the rationale qualifier — 「那些多出來的雜訊指令」 — and optionally carry the G=16 condition. The earlier forward reference in the fourth paragraph (「論文後面談到的雜訊指令會拖累正確指令的遵循率」) is already free of the qualifier and needs no change.

claims.claim_text: 受控實驗驗證的規模是 2-3 條指令的最優集合，而真實 CLAUDE.md 檔案的中位數指令數是 39 條——機制在小規模下成立，不代表在 39 條規則彼此纏繞的真實檔案裡效果一樣乾淨
claims.location: under H2「把理由寫進 comment……」, limitations paragraph
claims.evidence: covers of two or three instructions against a median file's 39 (Appendix A.7)
claims.note: The post reproduces the paper's own self-declared scale limitation and does not over-claim beyond it. Note the paper's limitations section also says 'An operator deploying the protocol should keep a person in the deletion path and hold safety-relevant instructions out of scope until someone tests the protocol on them' — the post omits the human-in-the-loop caveat that the ledger spine point 7 records. Omission only, no misstatement.

claims.claim_text: coding agent 工具可以提供 comment 語法，讓一條指令的隱性理由能傳到下一個維護者手上，但這仍然是「可以」，不是已經驗證過在真實規模下同樣有效的定論
claims.location: under H2「把理由寫進 comment……」
claims.evidence: Coding agent developers can give prompts a comment syntax, so an instruction's latent reasoning can reach the next maintainer. (§6 Discussion)
claims.note: n20 records hedge 'hedged'; the post explicitly preserves the modal ('可以') and flags that it is not a validated-at-scale conclusion. Strength matched, arguably slightly deflated — never an error.
